texts390.text: A Squeekchain stream companion with a live OBS overlay and SQK tipping on Sepolia.
Point the overlay at a streamer wallet · no login, no database.
Viewers open the tip page, connect a wallet and send SQK on Sepolia.
The overlay reads the token's Transfer logs and fires an alert on stream.
Because tips are read from chain logs instead of a server, the overlay survives refreshes,
Static site · no backend · no custody
